label: Groundwater
source: NASA GLDAS-2.2 Catchment Land Surface Model (CLSM) with GRACE data assimilation, daily 0.25°, aggregated to 0.5° (land only)
citation: Li, B. et al. (2019). Global GRACE data assimilation for groundwater and drought monitoring. Water Resources Research 55. doi:10.5067/TXBMLX370XX8
method: Mann-Kendall with bias-corrected AR(1) variance correction (Yue & Wang 2004; quadratic detrending), Theil-Sen slope, Benjamini-Hochberg FDR

significance.scale: Colour range set by Africa's confirmed trends (90th percentile); stronger changes elsewhere show at full colour.
